_comment: World Server config. Secrets (ipc.secret, database.url) must come from process.env.

registration._comment: How this world server connects to and registers with the cluster server.

world._guildWarComment: EVE_GUILDWAR. Vanilla v19 ships this OFF (flyffevent.h default 0, set only by the boot-script GUILDWAR token). Turning it on enables PvP between warring guilds and the 2-hour war timer.
world._guildQuestComment: EVE_WORMON. Vanilla v19 ships this OFF (same default-0 mechanism, boot-script token WORMON). Turning it on lets a level-70 guild master open the one defined boss arena (QUEST_WARMON_LV1 -- one MI_CLOCKWORK1 in a Madrigal rect), world-exclusive, 60-min kill deadline + 20-min loot window. No quest rewards exist; the boss's normal drops are the only payout.

consumable._comment: Potion cooldown group fallback (ms). Items with propItem dwSkillReady use that instead.
